messages:
sarah: Quick idea, related to the intermittent tail-latency bug we've seen during hotkey storms — what if we make eviction decisions deterministic (seeded by tenant+epoch) in a debug mode so we can replay and compare traces across nodes?
ben: hmm interesting. replayability would make diffs much easier instead of chasing nondeterministic evict orders. :eyes:
lee: can you sketch how deterministic eviction would work? like pure ordering by score with tie-breaker from seed?
sarah: yeah, proposal: compute eviction_score = base_score + jitter(seed, key_id) where jitter is a stable pseudorandom function seeded with (tenant_id, epoch_id). When debug mode enabled, we fix epoch for a window so every node resolves ties identically. Without debug mode jitter is random per node.
maria: are we talking about changing production default or an opt-in flag? Concerned about fairness — deterministic tie-breaking could lock hotkeys to same slab repeatedly and starve others.
sarah: opt-in only. plan: add runtime flag `evict_mode: deterministic|probabilistic`. deterministic used only for repro + canary experiments. default stays probabilistic.
ben: tradeoffs: reproability vs fairness makes sense. also deterministic may make adversarial tenants easier to game if enabled accidentally. we need safeguards.
lee: implementation nit: we should avoid adding heavy computation to hot path. the jitter(seed, key_id) can be a cheap 64-bit xor-shift + mul + right shift to normalize. no allocations.
sarah: exact code sketch I had in mind:```c
uint64_t jitter(uint64_t seed, uint64_t key_hash) {
  uint64_t x = key_hash ^ seed;
  x ^= x >> 33;
  x *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdULL;
  x ^= x >> 33;
  return x;
}
```
then transform to [0,1) and add small epsilon to base_score.```
ben: nice. also we should pin seed to prefix_epoch so when we trigger a debug replay we set seed to a known value and freeze prefix handoffs for short window.
maria: operational concerns: how do we collect traces? We'll need deterministic eviction metric and a correlation id to join logs across replicas. deploy-bot can we add a tag when debug mode flips?
deploy-bot: noted. will emit `evict_debug=true` event and set `debug_eviction_seed=<seed>` in node metadata when flag is toggled.
lee: correctness question: does deterministic jitter break any invariants about lease handoff or prefix ownership? e.g., if eviction order is predictable, could prefills/handshakes assume certain residency patterns?
sarah: shouldn't change correctness invariants — it's purely tie-breaking within same eviction score bucket. We still respect lease ownership; eviction won't free in-use pinned pages. But we need to double-check interactions with demotion pipeline where we rely on randomized sampling to surface cold prefixes.
ben: good call. Without sampling randomness, demote scan might see correlated results across nodes. For debug mode we accept that bias, but add a 'hybrid' mode where deterministic seed is combined with small per-node salt so correlations are bounded.
maria: metric plan: measure variance of eviction_order_cross_nodes (new metric) and a replay_success boolean. Also track tail-95 latency change during experiment.
sarah: rollout plan: 1) implement opt-in flag + seed control, 2) small canary (2 nodes) with deterministic-only, run a scripted workload to reproduce tail spike, 3) run hybrid on 10% of nodes to measure production bias, 4) if safe, add debug tooling to do cross-node trace diffs.
lee: how do we trigger replay? we need to store the seed and snapshot of prefix_epoch and a compact list of keys observed for the window. storing all keys is heavy. maybe we snapshot a bloom filter + prefix fingerprint to limit data.
sarah: agreed, keep snapshots small. we'll capture: seed, prefix_epoch, hotkey_topk fingerprints (top 100) and a short window of eviction decisions (id + score). that's enough to compare.
ben: can we reuse existing telemetry pipeline? we already send topk hotkeys; just extend to include `evict_seed` and `evict_decisions` sampling.
maria: add safety runway: auto-disable deterministic mode if tail-99 latency worsens >10% for more than 30s.
sarah: action items: @ben iterate code sketch into a PR for eviction scorer by EOD Wednesday; @lee prototype the seed + small-salt hybrid; @maria own telemetry + alerting hooks; I'll add design doc and follow-up RFC note.
ben: LGTM, will add unit tests to assert identical eviction order across two simulated nodes given same seed.
lee: will also run a small network-partition test to ensure determinism doesn't hide handoff races.
maria: will prepare Grafana panels and an alert runbook.
sarah: thanks all. I think this will make the next repro way less painful. :party-parrot:
